**NTRT gap brief — Wednesday, 04 November 2026**

**Mode B — screener fallback.** TradingView public scanner; the ntrt backend was unreachable (`GET /health` → HTTP 000). Snapshot 09:04 ET, 25 min before the open.

**TL;DR**

- **The tape is an election tape, and it is broad: 427 names gapped ≥3%** (282 up, 145 down), with the *shape* set by the Democratic sweep —
- clean energy and health insurers bid, the AI-datacenter/Musk complex sold. Futures reversed overnight and now point **higher** (S&P +1.1%, Dow +1.5%, Nasdaq +1.1%).
- **The %ADV reality check:
- only 66 of those 427 names cleared 5% of their 30-day average daily volume.** 215 traded under 1% of ADV and 1 had no ADV history at all —
- the median gap in this screen is a quote, not a market.
- **The most consequential name is SPCX, −6.3% (~$120B of market cap on a $1.92T cap).** Democrat Gina Hinojosa won the Texas governorship promising an immediate data-center moratorium, and Texas holds ~27% of planned US data-center gigawatts —
- that is the trade, and CRWV −7.1%, IREN −5.6% and NBIS −4.1% are the same trade.

**Market backdrop**

- Democrats took the House and the Senate, and Gina Hinojosa won the Texas governorship on a data-center moratorium;
- equities sold the initial result, then reversed hard once the president said he accepts it. S&P futures +1.1% to 7683, Dow futures +1.5% (724 pts), Nasdaq futures +1.1%.
- Treasuries rallied and the dollar slipped — 10-year yield 4.925% (−2.7bp), DXY 101.33 (−0.53%) — while gold rose 2.9% back above $4,000 and silver jumped 4.4%;
- WTI fell 2.6% to $93.60 and bitcoin sat near $78.2K (+1.1%).

- The sector read is the cleanest part of the tape:
- solar and hydrogen bid on a policy shift (FSLR +8.1%, PLUG +9.9%, RUN +7.1%, ENPH +4.4%), health insurers bid on the same sweep (OSCR +8.4%, with HCA/MOH/CNC higher), and AMD's earnings beat lifted the chip complex —
- while the AI-datacenter and Musk complex sold (SPCX, TSLA, CRWV, IREN, NBIS, ORCL).
- Clean-energy names are up on *expectations*, not earnings: most of the group is still down sharply over three months.
- This is a crowded earnings day (MCD, UBER, CVS, ARM, QCOM, APP report after the close) with October auto sales due at 15.8M, so the backdrop can move under the gaps below.

**Worth your attention**

Gate: |gap| ≥ 3% **and** pre-market volume ≥ 5% of 30-day ADV. Sorted by absolute gap, worst first.

**Flags**

- **FIS -23.0% on 34.1% of ADV (2,157,279 shares)** — the guidance cut is a real market, not a quote:
- FY26 adj EPS guided to $5.82–5.89 from $6.15–6.24, with the CFO departing Nov 5. This is the cleanest large-cap guidance cut in the screen.
- **SPCX −6.3% on a $1.92T market cap —
- about $120B of value off pre-open.** The Texas governor's race is the catalyst, and it is a policy risk for the whole AI-datacenter build-out, not an SPCX operating story.
- **ALAB −6.6% contradicts its own print.** Astera Labs reported Q3 revenue of $585M (+154% y/y) and adj EPS of $1.32 vs $1.19 expected;
- Needham cut its target to $300 while keeping Buy. A beat sold at −6.6% on 6.1% of ADV is a multiple/positioning event, not a fundamentals event.
- **SEDG −8.0% against a clean-energy bid.** FSLR +8.1%, PLUG +9.9%, RUN +7.1%, ENPH +4.4% —
- SEDG fell anyway, and it did so on 41.9% of ADV, the heaviest pre-market book in the screen.
- No company-specific catalyst was found; treat it as the one divergence in the clean-energy bid.
- **Arithmetic distortions in the %ADV column — read the share count, not the percentage.** NRP +8.5% on **4,098 shares** = 18.9% of a ~21.7K ADV; LEN.B +3.0% on 8,081 shares;
- VMET +3.4% on 18,557; SCZM +9.3% on 29,233; THM +7.2% on 29,970; HELE +13.2% on 39,254. High percentages on tiny absolute books are quotes.
- **MARA −4.9% and BTDR −10.0% fell while bitcoin was +1.1%.** Neither is a crypto tape read, and no company news was found for either — flagged as unexplained prints.
- **VST −9.2% with no company news found** and earnings due Nov 6; it traded with the AI-datacenter power complex rather than on anything Vistra-specific.
- **Rows with no confirmed catalyst (33 of the 66 actionable names).** The `Why` cell for these names reads "No confirmed catalyst — issuer IR + wire scan":
- I checked the issuer's own release/IR feed and the wire and found nothing attributable by 09:04 ET.
- TE, RWT, BTDR, VRDN, PXED, SCZM, VST, USAS, NRP, ASM, SMRT, GLXY, EXK, MOD, SLDP, THM, NFGC, STRL, TREX, RVLV, TLRY, MARA, ANET, TRLV, NYT, AMZN, SNDK, VMET, OC, AAOI, LEN.B, TOYO, AXTI.
- For TBLA and VST the results/news are confirmed but the *reason for the move* is not; for the rest I found no attributable news at all.
- **The tape is live.** Snapshot 09:04 ET, open 09:30.
- The gap numbers are pre-open prints that moved repeatedly between 06:30 and 09:04 (DOX traded −38% to −42% across the morning, DDOG −16% to −17%).
- Re-pull before the open if you are trading these.

**Method, source health & caveats**

- **Primary source — TradingView public scanner: `POST https://scanner.tradingview.com/america/scan`, HTTP 200.** Run twice in one pass — `premarket_change` in `[3,1000]` (desc) and `[-1000,-3]` (asc) —
- and merged, so both sides are carried: 282 gainers + 145 decliners = **427 unique names at ≥3%**.
- One pull only; every table in this brief comes from that single 09:04 ET snapshot.
- **Filters held exactly as specified:** `type = stock` (**REITs included — not re-filtered**), `exchange != OTC`, `market_cap_basic >= 200,000,000`, gap ≥ 3%.
- **Importance measure:** `premarket_volume ÷ average_volume_30d_calc` = % of 30-day ADV.
- This is the only column in the screen that separates a market from a quote, and it is why the actionable table is 66 rows and not 427.
- One name has no ADV history; its %ADV is empty in the CSV, never 0.
- **ntrt backend: unreachable.** `NTRT_BASE_URL` unset; `GET http://127.0.0.1:8000/health` → **HTTP 000** (no response). Mode B fallback, as specified.
- **Prior-close verification:** the Nov 3 regular close used for every gap was re-checked against the MCP-over-HTTP bridge (`market-recap get_quotes`, 15 symbols) —
- **15/15 exact matches** to the cent (DOX 62.43, FIS 38.99, DDOG 220.52, TSLA 398.50, SPCX 141.31, ORCL 126.19 and 9 others). The gap base is sound.
- **Market backdrop source:** bridge `market-recap market_snapshot`, as_of 2026-11-04 14:04 UTC (futures, yields, FX, commodities, bitcoin);
- election and sector read from CNBC, Morningstar, StockTitan, RTTNews and the issuer's own release where quoted.
- **Yahoo JSON: 429 rate-limited on all 12 prior-close chart requests** — a rate limit, not missing data; it was not used.
- Yahoo pre-market prices and ranges were also deliberately not published:
- Yahoo returns volume 0 on every pre-market bar and goes stale on thin names, so it cannot source this brief's importance column at all.
- **MCP catalog probe:** `catalog_ok total=135 finance_tools=0` — the `mcp__*` finance tools are still not registered in this runtime.
- That is a fact about the runtime, not a source failure, and it is not counted as an error.
- **Could not be verified:** the *reason* for the sell-off in TBLA (results confirmed, cause not), and company-level catalysts for the 30+ names listed in Flag 8.
- No number in this brief was taken from memory — every gap, price, volume and %ADV comes from the 09:04 screener pull or the named verification source.
